name: compass
description: Guide significant decisions with the research-backed COMPASS framework (Clarify, Options, Measure, Pause, Anticipate, Settle, Score) — an interactive walkthrough or a fillable worksheet, synthesizing Kahneman, the Heath brothers' WRAP, Klein, Meehl, Tetlock, and Robbins.
